riverbank-forest-56.name: Riverbank Forest

animal-market-56.name: Animal Market

farm-supplies-6.name: Farm Supplies
farm-supplies-6.description: Pay 1 food to plow and/or pay 1 food for grain

resource-trade-6.name: Resource Trade

corral-6.name: Corral

claim-field-goods-tokens.description: Move the goods on your sown fields to your supply

grain-thief-protect.description: Skip reaping the grain field and gain 1 grain instead

scythe-harvest-field.name: Scythe Harvest

swap-field-grain-to-veg.description: Trade a fully sown grain field for 1 vegetable

reserve-fence-supply.description: Select card-held ordinary fence pieces for this fence action

renovate-house.description: Upgrade your house to the next material tier

card-choice.description: Make a choice from card options

moor-special-action-choice.description: Choose and resolve a Moor special action follow-up

Major_ClayOven.name: Clay Oven
Major_ClayOven.description:
[__Bake Bread__ action:]
<GRAIN> <ARROW-1X> 5<FOOD>
[When you build it, you can Bake immediately]

Major_StoneOven.name: Stone Oven
Major_StoneOven.description:
[__Bake Bread__ action:]
<GRAIN> <ARROW-2X> 4<FOOD>
[When you build it, you can Bake immediately]

Major_Well.name: Well
Major_Well.description: [Put 1 <FOOD> on the 5 next turns. At the start of each turn, collect the <FOOD>]

Major_Moor_PeatCharcoalKiln.name: Peat-charcoal Kiln
Major_Moor_PeatCharcoalKiln.description:
[Special action: __Cut Peat__]
+1<FUEL> if you have 0<HORSE>; +2<FUEL> if you have at least 1<HORSE>.
[Scoring]
3/5<FUEL> <ARROW-1X> 1/2<SCORE>

Major_Moor_ForestersLodge.name: Forester's Lodge
Major_Moor_ForestersLodge.description:
[Special action: __Fell Trees__]
Gain 1 extra <WOOD>, or 2 extra <WOOD> if you have at least 1<HORSE>.
[Scoring]
Gain 1 <SCORE> for each <FOREST> in your farmyard.

Major_Moor_RidingStables.name: Riding Stables
Major_Moor_RidingStables.description:
Place 1 <FOOD> on each remaining round space.
At the start of each round, gain that <FOOD> if you have at least 2<HORSE>.

Major_Moor_MuseumOfTheMoors.name: Museum of the Moors
Major_Moor_MuseumOfTheMoors.description:
These major improvements cost you 1 building resource less:
Well 1 <STONE>      Clay Oven 1 <CLAY>
Joinery 1 <WOOD>      Stone Oven 1 <STONE>
Pottery 1 <CLAY>      Forester's Lodge 1 <CLAY>
Basketmaker's Workshop 1 <REED>

Major_Moor_HeatingOven.name: Heating Oven
Major_Moor_HeatingOven.description:
Immediately gain 2<FUEL>.
When heating, heat 1 fewer room than you have.

Major_Moor_TiledOven.name: Tiled Oven
Major_Moor_TiledOven.description: Regardless of house size, you need at most 1<FUEL> to heat your entire home.

Major_ClayOven2.name: Clay Oven
Major_ClayOven2.description:
[__Bake Bread__ action:]
<GRAIN> <ARROW-1X> 5<FOOD>
[When you build it, you can Bake immediately]

Major_StoneOven2.name: Stone Oven
Major_StoneOven2.description:
[__Bake Bread__ action:]
<GRAIN> <ARROW-2X> 4<FOOD>
[When you build it, you can Bake immediately]

Major_Well2.name: Well
Major_Well2.description: [Put 1 <FOOD> on the 5 next turns. At the start of each turn, collect the <FOOD>]

A010_WoodenShed.name: Wooden Shed
A010_WoodenShed.description: This card can only be played via a __Major Improvement__ action. It provides room for one person. You may no longer renovate.

A106_SlurrySpreader.name: Slurry Spreader
A106_SlurrySpreader.description: In the field phase of each harvest, each time you take the last <GRAIN>/<VEGETABLE> from a field, you also get 2 <FOOD>/1 <FOOD>.

A128_RiparianBuilder.name: Riparian Builder
A128_RiparianBuilder.description: Each time another player uses the __Reed Bank__ accumulation space, you can build a room: if you build a clay/stone room, you get a discount of 1 <CLAY>/2 <STONE>.

A136_DrudgeryReeve.name: Drudgery Reeve
A136_DrudgeryReeve.description: If there are still 1/3/6/9 complete rounds left to play, you immediately get 1/2/3/4 <WOOD>. During scoring, each player with 1+/2+/3+ building resources of each type gets 1/3/5 bonus <SCORE>.

A014_CarpentersHammer.name: Carpenter's Hammer
A014_CarpentersHammer.description: Each time you build at least 2 wood/clay/stone rooms at once, you get a total discount of 2 <REED> as well as 2 <WOOD>/3 <CLAY>/4 <STONE>.

A017_ReclamationPlow.name: Reclamation Plow
A017_ReclamationPlow.description: After the next time you take animals from an accumulation space and accommodate all of them on your farm, you can plow 1 field.

A022_Telegram.name: Telegram
A022_Telegram.description: Add 1 to the current round for each fence in your supply and mark the corresponding round space. In that round only, you can place a person from your supply.

A023_StoneCompany.name: Stone Company
A023_StoneCompany.description: Immediately after each time you use a __Quarry__ accumulation space, you get a __Major or Minor Improvement__ action during which you must spend at least 1 <STONE>.

A028_ForestSchool.name: Forest School
A028_ForestSchool.description: You can consider the __Lessons__ action spaces not occupied. You can replace each <FOOD> that an occupation costs with <WOOD>.

A029_AleBenches.name: Ale-Benches
A029_AleBenches.description: In the returning home phase of each round, you can pay exactly 1 <GRAIN> from your supply to get 1 bonus <SCORE>. If you do, each other player gets 1 <FOOD>.

A003_PaperKnife.name: Paper Knife
A003_PaperKnife.description: Select 3 occupations in your hand. Select one of them randomly, which you can play immediately without paying an occupation cost.

A037_Bucksaw.name: Bucksaw
A037_Bucksaw.description: Each time you renovate, you can also pay 1 <WOOD> to get 1 bonus <SCORE> and 1 <GRAIN>.

A039_Chapel.name: Chapel
A039_Chapel.description: This is an action space for all. A player who uses it gets 3 bonus <SCORE>. If another player uses it, they must first pay you 1 <GRAIN>.

A040_PottersYard.name: Potter's Yard
A040_PottersYard.description: Immediately place 1 <CLAY> on each unused space in your farmyard. Each time you turn a space into a used space, you get the clay and you can immediately exchange it for 2 <FOOD>.

A041_VegetableSlicer.name: Vegetable Slicer
A041_VegetableSlicer.description: Each time you upgrade a Fireplace to a Cooking Hearth, you immediately get 2 <WOOD> and 1 <VEGETABLE> (not retroactively).

A053_Claypipe.name: Claypipe
A053_Claypipe.description: In the returning home phase of each round, if you gained at least 7 building resources in the preceding work phase, you get 2 <FOOD>.

A055_JunkRoom.name: Junk Room
A055_JunkRoom.description: Each time after you build an improvement, including this one, you get 1 <FOOD>.

A058_AsparagusKnife.name: Asparagus Knife
A058_AsparagusKnife.description: In the returning home phase of rounds 8, 10, and 12, you can take 1 <VEGETABLE> from exactly 1 vegetable field. You can immediately exchange it for 3 <FOOD> and 1 bonus <SCORE>.

A064_BarleyMill.name: Barley Mill
A064_BarleyMill.description: In the field phase of each harvest, you get 1 <FOOD> for each grain field that you harvest.

A065_SeedPellets.name: Seed Pellets
A065_SeedPellets.description: Each time before you take an unconditional __Sow__ action, you get 1 <GRAIN>.

A070_LiftingMachine.name: Lifting Machine
A070_LiftingMachine.description: At the end of each round that does not end with a harvest, you can move 1 <VEGETABLE> from one of your fields to your supply. (This is not considered a field phase.)

A071_ClearingSpade.name: Clearing Spade
A071_ClearingSpade.description: At any time, you can move 1 crop from a planted field containing at least 2 crops to an empty field.

A072_CalciumFertilizers.name: Calcium Fertilizers
A072_CalciumFertilizers.description: Each time you use a __Quarry__ accumulation space, add 1 additional good of the respective type to each of your planted fields growing a single type of crop.

A074_StableTree.name: Stable Tree
A074_StableTree.description: Each time you build 1 or more stables on your turn, place 1 <WOOD> on each of the next 3 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <WOOD>.

A079_GardenHoe.name: Garden Hoe
A079_GardenHoe.description: Each time you take an unconditional __Sow__ action planting <VEGETABLE> in at least 1 field, you get 1 <CLAY> and 1 <STONE>.

A081_InterimStorage.name: Interim Storage
A081_InterimStorage.description: Each time you use a clay/reed/stone accumulation space, place 1 <WOOD>/<CLAY>/<REED> on this card. At the start of rounds 7, 11, and 14, move all the goods on this card to your supply.

A082_WorkCertificate.name: Work Certificate
A082_WorkCertificate.description: Each time after you use an action space, you can take 1 building resource from a building resource accumulation space with at least 4 building resources on it.

A083_ShepherdsCrook.name: Shepherd's Crook
A083_ShepherdsCrook.description: Each time you fence a new pasture covering at least 4 farmyard spaces, you immediately get 2 sheep on this pasture.

A084_Silage.name: Silage
A084_Silage.description: In each returning home phase after which there is no harvest, you can pay exactly 1 <GRAIN> - even from a field - to breed exactly one type of animal.

A092_AdoptiveParents.name: Adoptive Parents
A092_AdoptiveParents.description: For 1 <FOOD>, you can take an action with offspring in the same round you get it. If you do, the offspring does not count as \ .

B010_Caravan.name: Caravan
B010_Caravan.description: This card provides room for 1 person.

B015_CarpentersBench.name: Carpenter's Bench
B015_CarpentersBench.description: Immediately after each time you use a wood accumulation space, you can use the taken wood (and only that) to build exactly 1 pasture. If you do, one of the fences is free.

B019_MoldboardPlow.name: Moldboard Plow
B019_MoldboardPlow.description: Place 2 field tiles on this card. Twice this game, when you use the __Farmland__ action space, you can also plow 1 field from this card.

B002_MiniPasture.name: Mini Pasture
B002_MiniPasture.description: Immediately fence a farmyard space, without paying <WOOD> for the fences. (If you already have pastures, the new one must be adjacent to an existing one.)

B021_HayloftBarn.name: Hayloft Barn
B021_HayloftBarn.description: Place 4 <FOOD> on this card. Each time you obtain at least 1 <GRAIN>, you also get 1 <FOOD> from this card. Once it is empty, you get a __Family Growth Even without Room__ action.

B023_FinalScenario.name: Final Scenario
B023_FinalScenario.description: Reveal the action space card for round 14. Only you can use it until round 14 starts.

B003_Moonshine.name: Moonshine
B003_Moonshine.description: Randomly select an occupation in your hand. Either play it for an occupation cost of 2 <FOOD>, or give it to the next player.

B034_SpecialFood.name: Special Food
B034_SpecialFood.description: The next time you take animals from an accumulation space and accommodate all of them on your farm, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each of these animals.

B038_FutureBuildingSite.name: Future Building Site
B038_FutureBuildingSite.description: Up until all other farmyard spaces are used, you cannot use the unused spaces that are orthogonally adjacent to your house (not even to build rooms).

B042_ForestInn.name: Forest Inn
B042_ForestInn.description: This is an action space for all. A player who uses it can exchange 5/7/9 <WOOD> for 8 <WOOD> and 2/4/7 <FOOD>. When another player uses it, they must first pay you 1 <FOOD>.

B048_ForestStone.name: Forest Stone
B048_ForestStone.description: Place 2 <FOOD> on this card. Each time you use a wood accumulation space, move 1 of these <FOOD> to your supply. Each time you use a stone accumulation space, add 2 <FOOD> to this card.

B055_MaintenancePremium.name: Maintenance Premium
B055_MaintenancePremium.description: Place 3 <FOOD> on this card. Each time you use a wood accumulation space, you get 1 <FOOD> from this card. Each time you renovate restock this card to 3 <FOOD>.

B065_GrainDepot.name: Grain Depot
B065_GrainDepot.description: If you paid <WOOD>/<CLAY>/<STONE> for this card, place 1 <GRAIN> on each of the next 2/3/4 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <GRAIN>.

B067_HandTruck.name: Hand Truck
B067_HandTruck.description: Each time before you take a __Bake Bread__ action, you also get 1 <GRAIN> for each of your people occupying an accumulation space.

B075_WoodWorkshop.name: Wood Workshop
B075_WoodWorkshop.description: Each time before you play or build an improvement, you get 1 <WOOD>.

B076_Ceilings.name: Ceilings
B076_Ceilings.description: Place 1 <WOOD> on the next 5 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <WOOD>. Remove the <WOOD> promised by this card from future round spaces the next time you renovate.

B081_Handcart.name: Handcart
B081_Handcart.description: Before each work phase, you can take 1 building resource from at most one <WOOD>/<CLAY>/<REED>/<STONE> accumulation space containing at least 6/5/4/4 building resources of the same type.

B094_StockProtector.name: Stock Protector
B094_StockProtector.description: Each time before you use the __Fencing__ action space, you get 2 <WOOD>. Immediately after that __Fencing__ action, you can place another person.

C001_Overhaul.name: Overhaul
C001_Overhaul.description: Immediately raze all of your fences, add up to 3 fences from your supply, and rebuild them. (You do not lose any animals during this.)

C010_BunkBeds.name: Bunk Beds
C010_BunkBeds.description: Once you have 4 rooms, your house can hold 5 people.

C013_WoodSlideHammer.name: Wood Slide Hammer
C013_WoodSlideHammer.description: On your first renovation, if you have at least 5 wood rooms, you can renovate to stone directly and you get a discount of 2 <STONE> on the renovation cost.

C130_OutskirtsDirector.name: Outskirts Director
C130_OutskirtsDirector.description: Each time you use the __Grove__ or __Hollow__ accumulation space, you can place 2 <REED> from the general supply on the other space. If you do, you can immediately place another person.

C168_AnimalCatcher.name: Animal Catcher
C168_AnimalCatcher.description: Each time you use the __Day Laborer__ action space, instead of 2 <FOOD>, you can get 3 different animals from the general supply. If you do, you must pay 1 <FOOD> each harvest left to play.

C017_NewlyPlowedField.name: Newly-Plowed Field
C017_NewlyPlowedField.description: When you play this card, you can immediately plow 1 field, which needs not be adjacent to another field.

C018_RollOverPlow.name: Roll-Over Plow
C018_RollOverPlow.description: At any time, if you have at least 3 planted fields, you can discard all goods from one of those fields to plow 1 field.

C019_SwingPlow.name: Swing Plow
C019_SwingPlow.description: Place 4 field tiles on this card. Each time you use the __Farmland__ action space, you can also plow up to 2 fields from this card.

C022_BasketChair.rules: Only an adult person can be moved to this card; a newborn remains on its action space.

C023_JobContract.name: Job Contract
C023_JobContract.description: If both are unoccupied, you can use the __Day Laborer__ and the adjacent __Lessons__ action space with a single person (in that order). Afterward, both spaces are considered occupied.

C024_BedintheGrainField.name: Bed in the Grain Field
C024_BedintheGrainField.description: At the start of the next harvest, you get a __Family Growth__ action if you have room for the newborn.

C025_SteamMachine.name: Steam Machine
C025_SteamMachine.description: Each work phase, if the last action space you use is an accumulation space, you can immediately afterward take a __Bake Bread__ action.

C027_Blueprint.name: Blueprint
C027_Blueprint.description: You can build the major improvements __Joinery__, __Pottery__, and __Basketmaker\\

C029_BeerTable.name: Beer Table
C029_BeerTable.description: At the end of the field phase of each harvest, you can pay 1 <GRAIN> from your supply to get 2 bonus <SCORE>. If you do, all other players get 1 <FOOD> each.

C031_WritingChamber.name: Writing Chamber
C031_WritingChamber.description: During scoring, you get a number of bonus <SCORE> equal to the total of negative points you have, to a maximum of 7 <SCORE>.

C037_DwellingMound.name: Dwelling Mound
C037_DwellingMound.description: From now on, you must pay 1 <FOOD> for each new field tile that you place in your farmyard.

C051_FishingNet.name: Fishing Net
C051_FishingNet.description: Each time another player uses the __Fishing__ accumulation space, they must first pay you 1 <FOOD>. Then, in the returning home phase of that round, place 2 <FOOD> on __Fishing__.

C052_HuntsmansHat.name: Huntsman's Hat
C052_HuntsmansHat.description: For each new <PIG> you get from the effect of an action space, you also get 1 <FOOD>.

C057_Crudite.name: Crudité
C057_Crudite.description: When you play this card, you can immediately buy exactly 1 <VEGETABLE> for 3 <FOOD>. At any time, you can discard 1 <VEGETABLE> on top of another <VEGETABLE> in a field to get 4 <FOOD>.

C060_SmallPottersOven.name: Small Potter's Oven
C060_SmallPottersOven.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 5 <FOOD>. Each time before you get a __Bake Bread__ action, you can build the __Clay Oven__ or __Stone Oven__ major improvement.

C063_CraftBrewery.name: Craft Brewery
C063_CraftBrewery.description: In the feeding phase of each harvest, you can use this card to exchange 1 <GRAIN> from your supply plus 1 <GRAIN> from a field for 2 bonus <SCORE> and 4 <FOOD>.

C071_Slurry.name: Slurry
C071_Slurry.description: In the breeding phase of each harvest, if you get newborn animals of at least two types, you also get a __Sow__ action.

C075_Firewood.name: Firewood
C075_Firewood.description: In the returning home phase of each round, place 1 <WOOD> on this card. Each time after you build a Fireplace, Cooking Hearth, or oven, move up to 4 <WOOD> from this card to your supply.

C008_PlantFertilizer.name: Plant Fertilizer
C008_PlantFertilizer.description: In each field with exactly 1 good, you can immediately place 1 additional good of the same type.

C084_PerennialRye.name: Perennial Rye
C084_PerennialRye.description: Each round that does not end with a harvest, you can pay 1 <GRAIN> to breed exactly 1 type of animal. (This is not considered a breeding phase.)

D010_StorksNest.name: Stork's Nest
D010_StorksNest.description: In the returning home phase of each round, if you have more rooms than people, you can pay 1 <FOOD> to take a __Family Growth__ action.

D014_HammerCrusher.name: Hammer Crusher
D014_HammerCrusher.description: Immediately before you renovate to stone, you get 2 <CLAY> and 1 <REED> and you can take a __Build Rooms__ action.

D164_PetGrower.name: Pet Grower
D164_PetGrower.description: Each time you use an animal accumulation space, if afterward you have no animal in your house, you also get 1 <SHEEP>.

D020_TurnwrestPlow.name: Turnwrest Plow
D020_TurnwrestPlow.description: Place 2 field tiles on this card. Each time you use the __Farmland__ or __Cultivation__ action space, you can also plow up to 2 fields from this card.

D022_WorkPermit.name: Work Permit
D022_WorkPermit.description: Add 1 to the current round for each building resource you have and place 1 person from your supply on the corresponding round space. In that round, you can use the person.

D023_PioneeringSpirit.name: Pioneering Spirit
D023_PioneeringSpirit.description: This card is an action space for you only. In rounds 3-5, it provides a __Renovation__ action. In rounds 6-8, it provides your choice of 1 <VEGETABLE>, <PIG>, or <CATTLE>.

D025_WitchesDanceFloor.name: Witches' Dance Floor
D025_WitchesDanceFloor.description: This card is a field that you can sow in, an occupation, and the "Fireplace" major improvement with all of its effects. You can play it only via a __Minor Improvement__ action.

D026_CarpentersYard.name: Carpenter's Yard
D026_CarpentersYard.description: You can build the __Joinery__ and __Well__ major improvement even when taking a __Minor Improvement__ action, or you can build both with a single __Major Improvement__ action.

D027_Retraining.name: Retraining
D027_Retraining.description: At the end of each turn in which you renovate, you can exchange your __Joinery__ for the __Pottery__ or your __Pottery__ for the __Basketmaker\\

D036_BreedRegistry.name: Breed Registry
D036_BreedRegistry.description: During scoring, if you gained at most 2 <SHEEP> from sources other than breeding during the game and have not turned any sheep into food, you get 3 bonus <SCORE>.

D051_Archway.name: Archway
D051_Archway.description: This card is an action space for all. A player who uses it immediately gets 1 <FOOD>. Immediately before the returning home phase, they can use an unoccupied action space with the person from this card.

D053_TeaHouse.name: Tea House
D053_TeaHouse.description: Once per round, you can skip placing your second person and get 1 <FOOD> instead. (You can place the person later that round.)

D055_NewMarket.name: New Market
D055_NewMarket.description: Each time you use an action space card on round spaces 8 to 11, you get 1 additional <FOOD>.

D066_PotterCeramics.name: Potter Ceramics
D066_PotterCeramics.description: Each time before you take a __Bake Bread__ action, you can exchange 1 <CLAY> for 1 <GRAIN>.

D070_StrawManure.name: Straw Manure
D070_StrawManure.description: Before the field phase of each harvest, you can pay 1 <GRAIN> from your supply to add 1 <VEGETABLE> to each of up to 2 vegetable fields.

D071_Changeover.name: Changeover
D071_Changeover.description: At any time, if a field contains exactly 1 good as a result of a harvest, you can discard that good and immediately take a __Sow__ action limited to that field.

D072_StableManure.name: Stable Manure
D072_StableManure.description: In the field phase of each harvest, you can harvest 1 additional good from a number of fields equal to the number of unfenced stables you have.

D074_RoyalWood.name: Royal Wood
D074_RoyalWood.description: At the end of each turn in which you use the __Farm Expansion__ action space or build an improvement, you get 1 <WOOD> back for every 2 <WOOD> paid during those actions (rounded down).

D092_ChildOmbudsman.name: Child Ombudsman
D092_ChildOmbudsman.description: From round 5 on, if you have room in your house, at the end of each person action, you can take a __Family Growth__ action with that person. If you do, you get 2 negative <SCORE>.

E010_StrawHat.name: Straw Hat
E010_StrawHat.description: At the end of the work phases of rounds 3 and 6, you can move your person from the __Farmland__ action space to an unoccupied action space and take that action, or get 1 <FOOD>.

E016_BriarHedge.name: Briar Hedge
E016_BriarHedge.description: You do not need to pay wood for fences that you build on the edge of your farmyard board.

E022_GuestRoom.name: Guest Room
E022_GuestRoom.description: Immediately place any amount of <FOOD> from your supply on this card. Once per round, you can discard 1 <FOOD> from this card to place a person from your supply in that round.

E027_PiggyBank.name: Piggy Bank
E027_PiggyBank.description: At the end of each work phase, you can place 1 <FOOD> on this card, irretrievably. At any time, you can discard 6 <FOOD> from this card to build a major improvement at no cost.

E030_ChildsToy.name: Child's Toy
E030_ChildsToy.description: During the feeding phase of each harvest, your newborns require 2 <FOOD> (instead of 1).

E033_BeaverColony.name: Beaver Colony
E033_BeaverColony.description: From now on, one of your pastures with stable cannot hold animals. Each time you get <REED> from an action space, you get 1 bonus <SCORE>.

E036_HerbalGarden.name: Herbal Garden
E036_HerbalGarden.description: From now on, at least one of your pastures must contain no animals.

E004_Thunderbolt.name: Thunderbolt
E004_Thunderbolt.description: Immediately remove all <GRAIN> from one of your fields to the general supply. Gain 2 <WOOD> for each <GRAIN> you just removed.

E005_NightLoot.name: Night Loot
E005_NightLoot.description: Immediately remove 2 different building resources total from accumulation spaces and place them in your supply.

E051_WhaleOil.name: Whale Oil
E051_WhaleOil.description: Each time you use __Fishing__, place 1 <FOOD> from the general supply on this card. Each time before you play an occupation, you get <FOOD> equal to the amount on this card.

E052_Cubbyhole.name: Cubbyhole
E052_Cubbyhole.description: For each room that you add to your house, place 1 <FOOD> from the general supply on this card. At the start of each feeding phase, you get <FOOD> equal to the amount on this card.

E053_BoarSpear.name: Boar Spear
E053_BoarSpear.description: Each time you get at least 1 <PIG> outside of the breeding phase of a harvest, you can immediately turn them into 4 <FOOD> each.

E062_SourDough.name: Sour Dough
E062_SourDough.description: Once per round, if all players have at least 1 person left to place, you can skip placing a person and take a __Bake Bread__ action instead.

E071_CowPatty.name: Cow Patty
E071_CowPatty.description: Each time you sow in a field that is orthogonally adjacent to a pasture, you can place 1 additional good of the planted type in it.

E073_Scythe.name: Scythe
E073_Scythe.description: During the field phase of each harvest, you can select exactly one of your fields and harvest all the crops planted in it.

E074_AshTrees.name: Ash Trees
E074_AshTrees.description: When you play this card, immediately place (up to) 5 fences from your supply on it. When you build fences, fences taken from this card cost you nothing.

E075_StoneAxe.name: Stone Axe
E075_StoneAxe.description: Each time you use a wood accumulation space, you can return 1 <STONE> to the general supply to get an additional 3 <WOOD>.

E076_LumberPile.name: Lumber Pile
E076_LumberPile.description: When you play this card, you can immediately return up to 3 <STABLE> from your farmyard board to your supply and get 3 <WOOD> for each.

E078_SleightofHand.name: Sleight of Hand
E078_SleightofHand.description: When you play this card, you can immediately exchange up to 4 building resources for an equal number of other building resources.

E081_AlchemistsLab.name: Alchemists Lab
E081_AlchemistsLab.description: This card is an action space for all. A player who uses it gets 1 building resource of each type they already have. If another player uses it, they must first pay you 1 <FOOD>.

E082_Profiteering.name: Profiteering
E082_Profiteering.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <FOOD>. Each time you use the __Day Laborer__ action space, you can exchange 1 building resource for another building resource.

E084_DollysMother.name: Dolly's Mother
E084_DollysMother.description: You only require 1 <SHEEP> to breed sheep during the breeding phase of a harvest. This card can hold 1 <SHEEP>.

M027_GardenPath.rules: During scoring, the player holding the __Garden Path__ token loses 1 <SCORE>. There is only one token: each time this card is played, move it to the player to the left. The previous holder no longer has it.

A105_BarrowPusher.name: Barrow Pusher
A105_BarrowPusher.description: For each new field tile you get, you also get 1 <CLAY> and 1 <FOOD>.

A108_MushroomCollector.name: Mushroom Collector
A108_MushroomCollector.description: Immediately after each time you use a wood accumulation space, you can exchange 1 <WOOD> for 2 <FOOD>. If you do, place the <WOOD> on the accumulation space.

A109_SmallTrader.name: Small Trader
A109_SmallTrader.description: Each time you take a __Major or Minor Improvement__ action, if you play a card from your hand instead of taking a major improvement from the board, you also get 3 <FOOD>.

A110_Roughcaster.name: Roughcaster
A110_Roughcaster.description: Each time you build at least 1 clay room or renovate your house from clay to stone, you also get 3 <FOOD>.

A112_ScytheWorker.name: Scythe Worker
A112_ScytheWorker.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <GRAIN>. In the field phase of each harvest, you can harvest 1 additional <GRAIN> from each of your grain fields.

A119_FirewoodCollector.name: Firewood Collector
A119_FirewoodCollector.description: Each time you use the __Farmland__, __Grain Seeds__, __Grain Utilization__, or __Cultivation__ action space, at the end of that turn, you get 1 <WOOD>.

A123_FrameBuilder.name: Frame Builder
A123_FrameBuilder.description: Each time you build a room/renovate, but only once per room/action, you can replace exactly 2 <CLAY> or 2 <STONE> with 1 <WOOD>.

A126_MasterWorkman.name: Master Workman
A126_MasterWorkman.description: Each time before you use an action space card on round spaces 1/2/3/4, you get 1 <WOOD>/<CLAY>/<REED>/<STONE>.

A127_Lodger.name: Lodger
A127_Lodger.description: This card provides room for one person, but only until the returning home phase of round 9. If, by then, there is no room elsewhere for that person, remove it from play.

A137_RiverineShepherd.name: Riverine Shepherd
A137_RiverineShepherd.description: Each time you use the __Sheep Market__ or __Reed Bank__ accumulation space, you can also take 1 good from the respective other accumulation space, if possible.

A144_Sequestrator.name: Sequestrator
A144_Sequestrator.description: Place 3 <REED> and 4 <CLAY> on this card. The next player to have 3 pastures/5 field tiles gets the 3 <REED>/4 <CLAY> (not retroactively).

A148_Woolgrower.name: Woolgrower
A148_Woolgrower.description: This card can hold a number of <SHEEP> equal to the number of completed feeding phases.

A162_ForestTallyman.name: Forest Tallyman
A162_ForestTallyman.description: Each time both the __Forest__ and __Clay Pit__ accumulation spaces are occupied, you can use this card as an action space to get 2 <CLAY> and 3 <WOOD>.

A165_PigBreeder.name: Pig Breeder
A165_PigBreeder.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <PIG>. Your <PIG> breed at the end of round 12 (if there is room for the new <PIG>).

A085_Homekeeper.name: Homekeeper
A085_Homekeeper.description: Exactly one clay or stone room in your house can hold an additional person if the room is adjacent to both a field and a pasture.

A087_Conservator.name: Conservator
A087_Conservator.description: You can renovate your wooden house directly to stone without renovating it to clay first.

A088_HedgeKeeper.name: Hedge Keeper
A088_HedgeKeeper.description: Each time you take a __Build Fences__ action, you do not have to pay <WOOD> for 3 of the fences you build.

A089_StablePlanner.name: Stable Planner
A089_StablePlanner.description: Add 3, 6, and 9 to the current round. You can place 1 stable on each corresponding round space. At the start of these rounds (not earlier), you can build the stable at no cost.

A094_LazySowman.name: Lazy Sowman
A094_LazySowman.description: Each time you decline an unconditional __Sow__ action on your turn, you can immediately place another person on an action space of your choice (even if it is occupied).
A094_LazySowman.rules: The additional person cannot be placed on __Meeting Place__.

A097_Freshman.name: Freshman
A097_Freshman.description: Each time you get a __Bake Bread__ action, instead of taking the action, you can play an occupation without paying an occupation cost (at most once per turn).

B100_Clutterer.name: Clutterer
B100_Clutterer.description: During scoring, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each card played after this one that has \  in its text.

B103_FieldMerchant.name: Field Merchant
B103_FieldMerchant.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <WOOD> and 1 <REED>. Each time you decline a __Minor/Major Improvement__ action, you get 1 <FOOD>/<VEGETABLE> instead.

B109_PaperMaker.name: Paper Maker
B109_PaperMaker.description: Immediately before playing each occupation after this one, you can pay 1 <WOOD> total to get 1 <FOOD> for each occupation you have in front of you.

B115_TinsmithMaster.name: Tinsmith Master
B115_TinsmithMaster.description: You can hold 1 additional animal in each pasture without a stable. Each time you sow in a field, you can place 1 additional crop of the respective type in that field.

B124_Trimmer.name: Trimmer
B124_Trimmer.description: In each work phase, after you enclose at least one farmyard space, you get 2 <STONE>. (Subdividing an existing pasture does not count.)

B136_HouseSteward.name: House Steward
B136_HouseSteward.description: If there are still 1/3/6/9 complete rounds left to play, you immediately get 1/2/3/4 <WOOD>. During scoring, each player with the most rooms gets 3 bonus <SCORE>.

B146_Illusionist.name: Illusionist
B146_Illusionist.description: Each time you use a building resource accumulation space, you can discard exactly 1 card from your hand to get 1 additional building resource of the accumulating type.

B149_OpenAirFarmer.name: Open Air Farmer
B149_OpenAirFarmer.description: When you play this card, you remove exactly 3 <STABLE> in your supply from play to build a pasture covering 2 farmyard spaces. You only need to pay a total of 2 <WOOD> for fences

B151_LittlePeasant.name: Little Peasant
B151_LittlePeasant.description: You immediately get 1 <STONE>. As long as you live in a wooden house with exactly 2 rooms, actions spaces—excluding Meeting Place—are not considered occupied for you.

B154_SheepKeeper.name: Sheep Keeper
B154_SheepKeeper.description: You can only play this card if you have less than 7 <SHEEP>. Once this game, when you have 7 <SHEEP> on your farm, you immediately get 3 bonus points and 2 <FOOD>.

B165_GameProvider.name: Game Provider
B165_GameProvider.description: Immediately before each harvest, you can discard 1/3/4 <GRAIN> from different fields to get 1/2/3 <PIG>.

B086_TruffleSearcher.name: Truffle Searcher
B086_TruffleSearcher.description: This card can hold a number of <PIG> equal to the number of completed feeding phases.

C115_Sower.name: Sower
C115_Sower.description: Each time you build a major improvement, place 1 <REED> from the general supply on this card. At any time, you can move the <REED> to your supply or exchange it for a __Sow__ action.

C120_AgriculturalLabourer.name: Agricultural Labourer
C120_AgriculturalLabourer.description: Place 8 <CLAY> on this card. For each <GRAIN> you obtain, you also get 1 <CLAY> from this card.

C133_Soldier.name: Soldier
C133_Soldier.description: During scoring, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each <STONE> + <WOOD> pair in your supply. You cannot score additional points for the resources scored with this card.

C138_AnimalFeeder.name: Animal Feeder
C138_AnimalFeeder.description: On the __Day Laborer__ action space, you also get your choice of 1 <SHEEP> or 1 <GRAIN>. Instead of that good, you can buy 1 <PIG> for 1 <FOOD> or 1 <CATTLE> for 2 <FOOD>.

C135_Constable.name: Constable
C135_Constable.description: If there are still 1/3/6/9 complete rounds left to play, you immediately get 1/2/3/4 <WOOD>. During scoring, each player with no negative points in any scoring line gets 3 bonus <SCORE>.

C142_MarketCrier.name: Market Crier
C142_MarketCrier.description: Each time you use the __Grain Seeds__ action space, you can get an additional 1 <GRAIN> and 1 <VEGETABLE>. If you do, each other player gets 1 <GRAIN>.

C146_WorkshopAssistant.name: Workshop Assistant
C146_WorkshopAssistant.description: Place unique pairs of different building resources on this card, one for each improvement you have built. Each time another player renovates, you may move one such pair to your supply.

C148_MudWallower.name: Mud Wallower
C148_MudWallower.description: Every fourth time you use an accumulation space, you get 1 <PIG>, held by this card.

C156_HoofCaregiver.name: Hoof Caregiver
C156_HoofCaregiver.description: Immediately add 1 <CATTLE> from the general supply to the __Cattle Market__ accumulation space. Afterward, for each cattle on __Cattle Market__, you get 1 <GRAIN> plus 1 <FOOD>.

C162_ForestOwner.name: Forest Owner
C162_ForestOwner.description: This card is an action space for all. If another player uses it, they get 3 <WOOD> and must give you 1 <WOOD> from the general supply. If you use it, you get 4 <WOOD>.

C085_DenBuilder.name: Den Builder
C085_DenBuilder.description: When you live in a clay or stone house, you can pay 1 <GRAIN> and 2 <FOOD>. If you do, for the rest of the game, this card provides room for exactly one person.

C086_LivestockFeeder.name: Livestock Feeder
C086_LivestockFeeder.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <GRAIN>. This card can hold 1 animal of any type for each <GRAIN> in your supply.

C087_Mason.name: Mason
C087_Mason.description: Place a stone room on this card. Once you have a stone house with at least 4 rooms, at any time, you can add that room without paying any building resources.

C088_CarpentersApprentice.name: Carpenter's Apprentice
C088_CarpentersApprentice.description: Wood rooms cost you 2 <WOOD> less. Your 3rd and 4th stable each cost you 1 <WOOD> less. Your 13th to 15th fence each cost you nothing.

C093_InnerDistrictsDirector.name: Inner Districts Director
C093_InnerDistrictsDirector.description: Each time you use the __Forest__ or __Clay Pit__ accumulation space, you can place 1 <STONE> from the general supply on the other space. If you do, you can immediately place another person.

C096_Merchant.name: Merchant
C096_Merchant.description: Immediately after each time you take a __Major or Minor Improvement__ or __Minor Improvement__ action, you can pay 1 <FOOD> to take the action a second time.

C099_GardenDesigner.name: Garden Designer
C099_GardenDesigner.description: At the start of scoring, you can place <FOOD> in empty fields. You get 1/2/3 bonus <SCORE> for each field in which you place 1/4/7 <FOOD>.

C104_Collector.name: Collector
C104_Collector.description: This card is an action space for you only. When you use it for the 1st/2nd/3rd/4th time, you get 1 <BEGGING> marker and 6/7/8/9 different good of your choice.

D100_LordoftheManor.name: Lord of the Manor
D100_LordoftheManor.description: During scoring, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each scoring category in which you score the maximum 4 points. (The bonus point is also awarded for 4 fenced stables.)

D101_SugarBaker.name: Sugar Baker
D101_SugarBaker.description: Each time after you use the __Grain Utilization__ action space, you can buy 1 bonus <SCORE> for 1 <FOOD>. Place the <FOOD> on the action space (for the next visitor).

D102_SampleStableMaker.name: Sample Stable Maker
D102_SampleStableMaker.description: At the start of each returning home phase, you can return a built stable to your supply to get 1 <WOOD>, 1 <GRAIN>, 1 <FOOD>, and a __Minor Improvement__ action.

D103_CanalBoatman.name: Canal Boatman
D103_CanalBoatman.description: Each time you use __Fishing__ or __Reed Bank__, you can pay 1 <FOOD> to immediately place another person on this card. If you do, you get your choice of 3 <STONE> or 1 <GRAIN> plus 1 <VEGETABLE>.

D107_Bellfounder.name: Bellfounder
D107_Bellfounder.description: In the returning home phase of each round, if you have at least 1 <CLAY>, you can use this card to discard all of your <CLAY> and get your choice of 3 <FOOD> or 1 bonus <SCORE>.

D115_FodderPlanter.name: Fodder Planter
D115_FodderPlanter.description: In the breeding phase of each harvest, for each newborn animal you get, you can sow crops in exactly 1 field.

D116_TreeInspector.name: Tree Inspector
D116_TreeInspector.description: This card is a 1 <WOOD> accumulation space for you only. Each time the newly revealed action space card is a __Quarry__ accumulation space, you must discard all <WOOD> from this card.

D124_Emissary.name: Emissary
D124_Emissary.description: At any time, you can place a good from your supply on this card to get 1 <STONE>. You must place different goods on this card. (<FOOD> is also considered a good.)

D126_FieldCultivator.name: Field Cultivator
D126_FieldCultivator.description: Pile 1 <WOOD>, 1 <CLAY>, 1 <REED>, 1 <STONE>, 1 <REED>, 1 <CLAY>, and 1 <WOOD> on this card. Each time you harvest a field tile, you can also take the top good from the pile.

D127_HardworkingMan.name: Hardworking Man
D127_HardworkingMan.description: This card is an action space for you only. If each other player has more rooms than you, it provides the __Day Laborer__, __Build Rooms__, and __Major Improvement__ actions (all three).

D131_CraftsmanshipPromoter.name: Craftsmanship Promoter
D131_CraftsmanshipPromoter.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <STONE>. You can build any of the major improvements in the bottom row of the supply board even when taking a __Minor Improvement__ action.

D132_HideFarmer.name: Hide Farmer
D132_HideFarmer.description: During scoring, you can pay 1 <FOOD> each for any number of unused farmyard spaces. You do not lose points for these spaces.

D134_OysterEater.name: Oyster Eater
D134_OysterEater.description: Each time the __Fishing__ accumulation space is used, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> and must skip placing your next person that round. (You can place the person on a later turn.)

D137_TradeTeacher.name: Trade Teacher
D137_TradeTeacher.description: Each time after you use a __Lessons__ action space, you can buy up to 2 different goods: <GRAIN>, <STONE>, <SHEEP>, and <PIG> for 1 <FOOD> each; <CATTLE> and <VEGETABLE> for 2 <FOOD> each.

D150_GodlySpouse.name: Godly Spouse
D150_GodlySpouse.description: Each time you take a __Family Growth__ action with the second person you place in a round, return the first person you placed home, unless it is on the __Meeting Place__ action space.

D151_SpinDoctor.rules: No card, including this one, can allow you to use __Meeting Place__ if it is already occupied.

D157_PartyOrganizer.name: Party Organizer
D157_PartyOrganizer.description: As soon as the next player but you gains their 5th person, you immediately get 8 <FOOD> (not retroactively). During scoring, if only you have 5 people, you get 3 bonus <SCORE>.

D158_BeanCounter.name: Bean Counter
D158_BeanCounter.description: Each time you use an action space on round spaces 1 to 8, place 1 <FOOD> on this card. Each time this cards has 3 <FOOD> on it, move the <FOOD> to your supply.

D167_PureBreeder.name: Pure Breeder
D167_PureBreeder.description: You immediately get 1 <WOOD>. After each round that does not end with a harvest, you can breed exactly one type of animal. (This is not considered a breeding phase.)

D085_Reader.name: Reader
D085_Reader.description: As soon as you have 6 (7 in draft mode) occupations in front of you (including this one), this card provides room for one person.
D085_Reader.rules: In simultaneous draft mode, the occupation threshold is fixed at 7, regardless of draft pool size.

D093_SheepInspector.name: Sheep Inspector
D093_SheepInspector.description: Once per work phase, after you complete a person action, you can pay 1 <SHEEP> and 2 <FOOD> to return another person you placed home, unless it is on the __Meeting Place__ action space.

D094_HenpeckedHusband.name: Henpecked Husband
D094_HenpeckedHusband.description: Each time you take a __Build Rooms__ action with the second person you place, return the first person you placed home, unless it is on the __Meeting Place__ action space.

D095_SiteManager.name: Site Manager
D095_SiteManager.description: When you play this card, immediately build a major improvement. When paying its cost, you can replace up to 1 building resource of each type with 1 <FOOD> each.

D098_Transactor.name: Transactor
D098_Transactor.description: Immediately before the final harvest at the end of round 14, you can take all the building resources that are left on the entire game board.

E103_Wolf.name: Wolf
E103_Wolf.description: Pile (from bottom to top) 1 <CLAY>, 1 <WOOD>, and 1 <GRAIN> on this card. Each time you get a good matching the top item, you can move that item to your supply and get 1 <PIG>.

E109_BraidMaker.name: Braid Maker
E109_BraidMaker.description: Each harvest, you can use this card to exchange 1 <REED> for 2 <FOOD>. You can build the  __Basketmaker\\

E112_GrainThief.name: Grain Thief
E112_GrainThief.description: Each time you would harvest a grain field, you can leave the grain on the field and take 1 <GRAIN> from the general supply instead.

E123_ResourceHoarder.name: Resource Hoarder
E123_ResourceHoarder.description: Pile resources as depicted on this card. You can use the top item(s) when building a room, playing/building an improvement, or renovating. (From bottom to top: <STONE>, <CLAY>, <STONE>, <REED>, <WOOD>, <CLAY>)

E124_MayorCandidate.name: Mayor Candidate
E124_MayorCandidate.description: You immediately get 2 <WOOD> and 2 <STONE>. During scoring, you get 1 negative point for each <WOOD> and each <STONE> in your supply. You can no longer discard <WOOD> or <STONE>.

E130_Overachiever.name: Overachiever
E130_Overachiever.description: Each time you use a __Wish for Children__ action space, you can play 1 additional improvement by paying its cost minus 1 resource of your choice.

E133_ChampionBreeder.name: Champion Breeder
E133_ChampionBreeder.description: Each time you place 2 or 3+ newborn animals on your farm during the breeding phase of the harvest, you get 1 or 2 bonus <SCORE>, respectively.

E134_Omnifarmer.name: Omnifarmer
E134_Omnifarmer.description: Each harvest, you can place 1 harvested crop or 1 newborn animal on this card, irretrievably. Once this game, if there are 2/3/4/5 different goods on this, you get 3/5/7/9 bonus <SCORE>.

E148_Lazybones.name: Lazybones
E148_Lazybones.description: Place (up to) 1 <STABLE> each on __Grain Seeds__, __Farmland__, __Day Laborer__, and __Farm Expansion__. Build the <STABLE> at no cost when another player uses that action space.

E151_DeliveryNurse.name: Delivery Nurse
E151_DeliveryNurse.description: Once this game, if you have all types of animals, you can use any __Wish for Children__ action space even without room.

E153_StoneSculptor.name: Stone Sculptor
E153_StoneSculptor.description: Each harvest, you can use this card to exchange exactly 1 <STONE> for 1 bonus <SCORE> and 1 <FOOD>.

E155_Visionary.name: Visionary
E155_Visionary.description: If you play this card in round 4 or before, you get 1 <STONE>, 1 <VEGETABLE>, and 2 <PIG>. You cannot grow your family until round 11, unless all other players already have.

E159_OldMiser.name: Old Miser
E159_OldMiser.description: In the feeding phase of each harvest, each of your people requires 1 less <FOOD>. During scoring, your people are worth 2 points each instead of 3.

E161_ElderBaker.name: Elder Baker
E161_ElderBaker.description: This card is an action space for you only. When you use it, you get 3 <GRAIN>. You can build the __Stone Oven__ major improvement even when taking a __Minor Improvement__ action.

E162_Entrepreneur.name: Entrepreneur
E162_Entrepreneur.description: At the start of each round, you can move 1 <FOOD> to this card or discard 1 <FOOD> from it. If you do either, you get 1 building resource of a type you currently do not have.

E166_Roastmaster.name: Roastmaster
E166_Roastmaster.description: Each time you use the __Traveling Players__ or __Fishing__ accumulation spaces, you can move exactly 1 <FOOD> from that space to the other to get 1 <CATTLE>.

E167_DairyCrier.name: Dairy Crier
